texts.preamble: M/S Prabhat Zarda Factory India Pvt. ... vs The State Of Bihar & Ors on 5 December, 2018 Author: Mohit Kumar Shah Bench: Mohit Kumar Shah In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna Civil Writ Jurisdiction Case No.22641 of 2018 ====================================================== M/s Prabhat Zarda Factory India Pvt. Ltd. ... ... Petit Versus The State Of Bihar & Ors ... ... Respondent/s = = = = = = Appearance : For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Prabhat Ranjan For the Respondent/s : Mr. Birju Prasad- Gp13 ======= == == == = ===================== = Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Mohit Kumar Shah Oral Order
texts.facts: The petitioner has challenged the order dated 25.10.2018 passed by the Commissioner, Food Safety, Government of Bihar, Patna, whereby and whereunder it has been directed a follows :- All the concerned officers are directed to ensure that there is no manufacture, sale, storage and transport of chewing tobacco mixed with food or food additives in strict compliance with Clause 2.3.4 of the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations, 2011, in the entire State of Bihar.
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is dealing with the item mentioned in Section 3(p) of the Cigarettes & Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003, which is Patna High Court CWJC No.22641 of 2018(2) dt.05-12-2018 reproduced hereinbelow :- 3(p)- In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires"tobacco products" means the products specified in the Schedule. The schedule referred to in the aforesaid section 3(p) of the Act, 2003 is further reproduced hereinbelow :- M/S Prabhat Zarda Factory India Pvt. ... vs The State Of Bihar & Ors on 5 December, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31663258/ 1 1. Cigarettes 2. Cigars 3. Cheroots 4. Beedis 5. Cigarette tobacco, pipe tobacco and hookah tobacco 6.Chewing tobacco 7. Snuff 8. Pan masala or any chewing material having tobacco as one of its ingredients (by whatever name called). 9. Gutka 10. Tooth powder containing tobacco. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is only dealing with the items mentioned in Section 3(p) of the Act, 2003, hence the authorities be directed not to disturb the functioning and working of the petitioner's company as also the petitioner be not disturbed from dealing with the products mentioned in Section 3(p) of the Act, 2003. The learned counsel for the respondents has appeared in the case and prays for a short time for filing counter affidavit, however the learned counsel for the respondents does not deny the application of Section 3(p) of the Act, 2003.
